scope: Unauthenticated GET only; no login, data writes, media transfer or release approval.

checks.reason: Record scientific, editorial, consent and release approvals for the exact artifact.
Use two authorized test accounts in separate browsers; verify login, logout and fresh login.
Create and accept an authorized invitation; verify the intended edition and capacity persist.
Prove anonymous, peer and other-edition denial for private Core records and assets.
Upload and replay authorized test media; compare original bytes and enforce private Storage access.
Verify local and global logout, stale JWT and in-flight private media after revocation.
Record, annotate, share and replay on a fresh device; verify session, digest, object version and revoked pins.
Retain canonical activity, submission, feedback and diary receipts for the same edition.
Verify restart, independent-device persistence and an isolated backup/restore drill.
Record authorized consent, retention, erasure and access ownership decisions without putting PII in evidence.
Review the exact source SHA, deployed artifact, Auth, Storage and RLS receipts independently.
